note: A thin, identity-only lexical reference for the optical-transport configuration case. One entry per concept: a stable id, a preferred label, synonyms, a shallow class, a disambiguating definition, and a single canonical example. Deliberately small and not a model of the domain.

entries.label: forwarding node
entries.definition: A device that forwards traffic and terminates links in the topology.

entries.label: link termination
entries.definition: The point on a node where a topological link terminates.
entries.example: the R1 end of the R1-R2 link

entries.label: layer adaptation
entries.definition: A relationship in which one layer is carried over, or adapts to, another.
entries.example: ODU2 adapted into an OTU4 server layer at R1

entries.label: trail termination
entries.definition: The origination or termination of a trail or tunnel, i.e. the head of an end-to-end path.
entries.example: the head of the A1-A3 ODU2 tunnel at A1

entries.label: client service access
entries.definition: The point at which an external client service accesses the network.
entries.example: the ODU2 client hand-off at access node A1

entries.label: connection service
entries.definition: An end-to-end connectivity service realised across the network.

entries.label: multiplex structure
entries.definition: The structure by which a signal is multiplexed into a server layer.
entries.example: ODU2 mapped into tributary slots of an OTU4

entries.label: switching constraint
entries.definition: A constraint on which ports or signals may be switched to which within a node.

entries.label: topological link
entries.definition: A link between two nodes in the topology.

entries.label: topology
entries.definition: The graph of nodes and links that describes the network.

entries.label: connection endpoint
entries.definition: An endpoint of a connection within a node, bound to a service.
entries.example: the connection endpoint for the A1-A3 service on R1
